title: Theo and the Orbit
author: T. M. Dunmore
blurb: Astrid Nakamura, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
